available_so_containers.title: Service Order Containers (choose from these)
available_so_containers.description: The placeholder containers your service order was priced against. They are not the real container numbers — consolidation is what ties each real container to one of them.

rows.title: Pre-advised Containers (real)
rows.description: The containers the terminal pre-advised against your declaration, by their real number. Tick each one to consolidate and enter which service order container it goes with.

cap_container_no.title: Real Container No
cap_container_no.description: As the terminal pre-advised it to SLPA.

so_container_no.title: Service Order Container
so_container_no.description: One of the placeholder numbers listed above. The two numbers are unrelated, so only you can say which goes with which.
